name: postgres-mcp-hardened
description: Read-only PostgreSQL MCP server in Rust: AST-enforced read-only queries plus database-level read-only transaction, per-session statement_timeout, schema inspection.

database_url.title: PostgreSQL connection string
database_url.description: PostgreSQL connection string (postgres:// URL). Use a read-only role for defense in depth.

max_cost.title: Max query cost (EXPLAIN planner estimate)
max_cost.description: Reject queries whose estimated planner cost exceeds this value.

client_id.title: Name this client in the audit log
client_id.description: Written into every audit record over stdio, e.g. claude-desktop@my-laptop. Without it the log identifies you by operating-system user and process id.

redact_columns.title: Columns to keep out of results
redact_columns.description: Comma-separated, e.g. password,ssn. Defence in depth: values are masked and the columns cannot be referenced. The boundary is a database privilege — run --print-setup-sql for the statements that create it.

tools.name: security_posture
tools.description: What this server can and cannot do
